title: AERO9500 Preliminary Report (Part 1) – Space Mission Design
overview: Design a simple space mission benefiting Australia and identify main space-segment elements (launch, orbits, etc.) using chosen mission-design software, supplemented by hand calculations as needed. Part 1 is a preliminary report laying out the mission concept and rationale, project plan, and preliminary technical progress.
deliverables: Preliminary report (Part 1) as a single PDF
Project plan with Gantt chart or timetable and planned information sources
Preliminary technical progress/evidence of work done to date

format.structure: Sections covering mission concept/rationale, project plan, and preliminary progress
format.other: Single PDF; use chosen software (STK, PIGI, or other approved) and supplement with hand calculations as needed

requirements.text: Design a space mission that benefits Australia in some way.
Identify the main elements of the mission's space segment, applying course material on launch, orbits, and related systems.
Develop a preliminary plan for the new mission.
Present the mission concept and rationale: what it will do, who the users are, and why it is needed.
Provide a project plan for completing the assignment, including a Gantt chart or timetable.
List the sources of information planned for use.
Decide and state which software package is being used (e.g., STK, PIGI, or other).
Contact the instructor before starting work with software other than STK or PIGI.
Use software of choice to complete the design, supplementing with hand calculations as needed.
Present preliminary progress with technical content and evidence of sufficient work done to date.
Submit the report as a single PDF document.
